key_moments: Leandro Trossard opened the scoring for Belgium in the 28th minute.
Kevin De Bruyne's goal in the 66th minute extended Belgium's lead to 3-0, a crucial moment for their goal difference.
Elijah Just scored a consolation goal for New Zealand in the 84th minute, briefly impacting Belgium's group-topping position.
Romelu Lukaku scored with his first touch in the 86th minute after coming on as a substitute, restoring Belgium's comfortable lead.

standout_performers.reason: Scored two goals and provided an assist, driving Belgium's attack.
Scored a stunning goal and dictated play from midfield, contributing significantly to the dominant performance.
Scored New Zealand's only goal and was a persistent threat in attack.

matches.tactical_summary: Belgium displayed a dominant attacking performance, controlling the midfield and converting their chances efficiently to secure a large victory. New Zealand struggled to contain Belgium's offensive power but managed to break through for a consolation goal, showcasing some resilience despite being outmatched.

narrative: Belgium secured a resounding 5-1 victory over New Zealand, topping Group G and advancing to the knockout stages of the World Cup. This dominant performance marked their first win of the tournament, while New Zealand's campaign ended without a victory, finishing at the bottom of the group.
